notes.title: Updated to ver1.02b
notes.content:
The change in the return process had affected the 9-3 moving block, so we have made an immediate correction, though only for the time being.
It mainly affected me greatly when I was playing with two people.
We apologize for the inconvenience.......

・Other Fixs
Fixed a phenomenon in which the game does not go over when two players are playing in the "Challenge" mode.

tags.bug: Fixed a phenomenon in which the game does not go over when two players are playing in the "Challenge" mode.

notes.title: ver1.01にアップデートしました。
notes.content:
After 9W, the Extra World! So it is difficult to do,
Since there were a few comments about the difficulty of the game, we will  strengthen Alice-chan in normal mode a little.
Thank you for playing along so quickly.......

We are of course glad that you are willing to try, but it would be sad if you feel that the difficulty is not fun...

・The initial life was enhanced by 1 to 5 and the max life by 6.
・The return process when falling into a hole, etc., was to return to the final landing point,
　--When there is no operation, it goes to the final landing point as before and returns at that point.
　--Stick input to operate for a certain period of time.
　--The jump button (and the skill button) can be used to exit the return state.

Changed as above.
You may retry the same areas, and it will be possible to pass on some areas that you don't like.
Although you can go to some extraordinary places if you use it, we decided to make it a priority to enjoy it.

If you want to play hard, there will be a hard-working mode, and we will make various modifications to the normal mode to make it easier to play.
I'm also thinking that the hard work mode could be increased by 1 maximum life with the initial life remaining the same.
How about this?

notes.title: Updated to ver 0.83.
notes.content:
・When scrolling the screen by pressing and holding the up/down directional buttons or inputting the right stick, the scrolling did not stop cleanly at the end of the screen.

・Because the flag for achievements is only checked when a stage is cleared,
Fixed a problem where the timing of unlocking achievements for which a book was acquired could be off.

・Fixed that some messages were out of frame in English.
